name: mul_slash
statement: ℤ) (A : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (f g : ℍ → ℂ) : (f * g) ∣[k1 + k2] A = |(A.det : ℝ)| • (f ∣[k1] A * g ∣[k2] A)

name: prod_fintype_slash
statement: Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] {k : ℤ} {g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ} {f : ι → ℍ → ℂ} : (∏ i, f i) ∣[k * Fintype.card ι] g = |g.det.val| ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) • (∏ i, f i ∣[k] g)
